summary: The page is a careful and correct treatment of splitting in quadratic fields, Gauss sums, and quadratic reciprocity via Frobenius elements. I checked the Legendre symbol definition, Euler's criterion proof, the quadratic splitting theorem (including p=2 cases), the Gauss sum computation g^{2}=p^{*}, the Frobenius restriction lemma, the reciprocity proof, the second supplementary law via Q(ζ_8), the two-squares example, the hypcheck, and the problems/solutions. All statements and citations appear correct; the one candidate issue I examined (the explicit √5 in Q(ζ_5)) turned out to be correct on direct computation, so I report no issues.
